scenes.heading: Experience Fragments Development and Tips
scenes.narration: Workflows. Experience Fragments Development and Tips. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: Which sling:resourceType is used by an Experience Fragment master or variation?
scenes.heading: Experience Fragment masters and variations use sling:resourceType cq/experience-fragments/components/xfpage
scenes.body: The speech says a fragment master or variation uses the sling:resourceType cq/experience-fragments/components/xfpage, which falls back to the core page component through sling:resourceSuperType.
scenes.narration: Which sling:resourceType is used by an Experience Fragment master or variation? scenes.question: Which selector requests the plain HTML rendition of an Experience Fragment for third-party consumption?
scenes.heading: Use the .plain. selector to request the plain HTML rendition
scenes.body: The speech says the plain HTML rendition is requested with the .plain. selector, for example master.plain.html, so third-party applications can read the fragment by URL.
scenes.narration: Which selector requests the plain HTML rendition of an Experience Fragment for third-party consumption? Use the .plain. selector to request the plain HTML rendition. The speech says the plain HTML rendition is requested with the .plain. selector, for example master.plain.html, so third-party applications can read the fragment by URL.

scenes.question: What does the plain HTML rendition rewrite in links and resource attributes?
scenes.heading: It adds protocol, host, and context path, and its links point to the publish instance
scenes.body: The speech says the plain HTML rendition adds protocol, host, and context path to src, href, and action attributes and attributes ending in -src or -href, and that links always reference the publish instance.

scenes.question: How is the plain Experience Fragment rendition built, and what customization rule accompanies it?
scenes.heading: It is built by the Sling Rewriter pipeline, and you should overlay the configuration instead of editing /libs
scenes.body: The speech says the plain rendition is built by the Sling Rewriter pipeline under the experience-fragments rewriter configuration and says to overlay the configuration rather than editing it in /libs.

scenes.question: How can an Experience Fragment template be recognized by the Create wizard?
scenes.heading: Its resource type must inherit from cq/experience-fragments/components/xfpage and its name begin with experience-fragment, or Allowed Templates must be configured
scenes.body: The speech says an Experience Fragment template must either inherit from cq/experience-fragments/components/xfpage and have a name beginning with experience-fragment, or Allowed Templates must be configured in the console.

scenes.question: What extra development step applies to components that will be used inside Experience Fragments?
scenes.heading: Allow the components on the template with the content policy
scenes.body: The speech says components used in fragments follow standard component practices, and the only extra step is allowing them on the template with the content policy.

scenes.question: What does Export to Target do for an Experience Fragment?
scenes.heading: Export to Target sends the Experience Fragment to Adobe Target as an offer in HTML or JSON
scenes.body: The speech says Export to Target sends a fragment to Adobe Target as an offer, in HTML or JSON format.
